hypothesis: Compared with the controlled 1024_cascade baseline, 1536_cascade will use a smaller voxel size and may preserve repeated shelf boundaries and recesses more clearly, at the cost of additional generation time and peak CUDA memory.

image_conditioned_cases.source_provenance: Original photograph captured on location by the author.
image_conditioned_cases.selection_rationale: Use a freestanding bookshelf to evaluate whether 1536_cascade preserves repeated recesses, planar surfaces, thin shelves, asymmetry, and hidden interior structure more clearly than the controlled 1024_cascade baseline.
